educationalModelNote: All numerical models are simplified educational models, not specifications of a real robot.

missions.title: EVIDENCE DISCIPLINE
missions.concept: Engineering claims must be separated into verified fact, observation, hypothesis, requirement and verification evidence; confidence cannot exceed evidence quality.
missions.scenario: Review a design claim before presenting it as a released fact.
missions.goalText: Make claim strength match the available evidence.
missions.transferText: Reduce the claim or improve evidence after source independence drops.

missions.title: SYSTEM DESIGN REVIEW
missions.concept: A design review closes decisions only when cross-domain risks, requirements and evidence are visible; attractive presentation is not closure.
missions.scenario: Decide whether a subsystem is ready for release or needs open actions.
missions.goalText: Reach review readiness by closing issues and evidence gaps.
missions.transferText: Re-open the review until the new issue is actually resolved.

missions.title: ZONE REVIEW
missions.concept: A physical zone must satisfy motion, thermal, sensing, service and safety envelopes simultaneously; local styling cannot be reviewed in isolation.
missions.scenario: Review a shoulder cover against swept volume, heat rejection and sensor visibility.
missions.goalText: Pass all three envelopes rather than optimizing the cover for only one discipline.
missions.transferText: Recover cross-domain margin after the service feature is added.

missions.title: REQUIREMENTS & RFIs
missions.concept: A strong RFI turns uncertainty into a precise engineering question tied to a decision, owner and acceptance evidence.
missions.scenario: Prioritize which unresolved requirement must be clarified before design release.
missions.goalText: Reduce ambiguity or obtain evidence before treating the requirement as released.
missions.transferText: Escalate/clarify the late requirement instead of silently assuming an implementation.

missions.title: CHANGE IMPACT & TRACEABILITY
missions.concept: A design change propagates through dependent interfaces and invalidates evidence; traceability tells you what must be rechecked.
missions.scenario: Assess a joint-cover change that touches thermal, sensing and service interfaces.
missions.goalText: Create enough retest coverage for the change's dependency footprint.
missions.transferText: Expand traceability when the dependency footprint grows.

missions.title: FINAL DESIGN DEFENSE
missions.concept: Defend the complete humanoid design by matching claims to evidence, preserving system margins and tracing change impact across disciplines.
missions.scenario: Final cross-functional review: release, conditionally release or keep open based on evidence.
missions.goalText: Complete the final three design-defense cases.

gateCases.name: ENGINEERING MARGIN
gateCases.text: No release with system margin below 55%.

gateCases.name: TRACEABLE RELEASE
gateCases.text: All three axes ≥70% and weighted defense score ≥75%.
